notes: Single continuation sheet of an English letter: one opening continuation line, one long indented body paragraph, typed closing and rightward handwritten signature. There is no date, title, salutation, authorial page number, or total page count here. The bottom-left 22 is an archival number, recorded only as a comment.

The text asks for information about the canonical Lie-algebra morphism and Steinberg’s group morphism, their ranks, and unipotent orbits. “There are some reasons to believe” introduces the proposed ranks; this is not phrased as a proved result.

The orbit paragraph says “I would expect that there is just one orbit” and “maybe this property will be caracteristic”. Both hesitations are preserved. The source spellings analoguous and caracteristic differ from C’s normalized-looking words.

For an orbit of dimension 2N-2i the author says “I would expect the dimension of the previous variety to be equal to i”. The inequality statement is conditional: “would imply”. No proof of the proposed inequality or of rational singularities is supplied on this page.

The small formula asserts vanishing for i>0, with a cancelled mark retained at the upper-right of the underlined O. Its questionable shape was examined for strokes rather than reconstructed from the vanishing statement.
The source retains beinteresting, how varies, rang, and singular answer followed by are well known. No correction of English syntax or agreement is made.
C/H agreement at answer concealed an additional rounded contour in the w-like cell and an extra upright at e. Both are reproduced with local doubt from the already-required to crop.

The vertical trace above e in beinteresting has no secure function; it is drawn as seen. The isolated point by the n- leader and the disconnected lower-page trace are likewise not assigned a mathematical role.

The H editorial note is witness apparatus, not source text. It explicitly describes n- and all as handwritten and the subscripts as overstruck; only its actual uncertain markers on A/D count as marked_in_H.
No other page images, other readers’ outputs, root decisions, OCR, recognition service, web source, or external mathematical edition were consulted.
